packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/objc-reference-clang/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, so the Linux job fails on the bump until the linux-sha256 beside the moved version names the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace components/objc-reference-clang/linux-sha256 with the `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/objc-reference-clang/linux-sha256`.
